Name: The Queen of Sauce Cookbook
Author: AeraDreamer
Description:
[size=5][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][u][center]~~~Introduction~~~[/center][/u][/color][/font][/size]

[font=Arial][size=3]This mod was made to help all those diligent farmers who missed the TV show to make all that arduous work in their property or around it… With this they don’t need to watch the dreadful reruns…[/size][/font]

[size=3]It's intended to those who missed one or another recipe, so, you should know that if you choose to learn all the recipes in the first year or second year, you will receive a lot of mail from every one. For those who wish to rush ahead, good readings![/size]

[size=4]* I'm working in ways to easy the amount of mail received, for now I can reduce the amount of letters after reading the book.[/size]

[size=3]It is my first mod and English is not my first language. So I ask for patience and please, feel free to report every problem you find I'll do my best to work it out![/size]

[center][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=5][u]~~~ What [/u][u]you will find ~~~[/u][/size][/color][/font][/center]
[font=Arial]
[/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][b]32 new quests :[/b] All of then related to the recipes learned in the Queen of Sauce show and received by mail;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][b]02 new items :[/b] the Queen of Sauce Cookbook and the Queen of Sauce Exclusive Edition, both sold by Pierre;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][b]02 ways of configuring :[/b] Available[u] from year 1[/u] or [u]from year 3[/u](default).[/size][/font]
[/list]
[size=5][u][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][center]﻿[/center][center]~~~ Warnings about the Cookbook ~~~[/center][/color][/font][/u][/size][size=3]
[/size][font=Arial][size=3]The quests are not mandatory, you don't need to make them, but [color=#ffff00]if you have ever learn a recipe with the TV show, read all your mail BEFORE buying the Queen of Sauce Cookbook. [/color][/size][size=3](This is necessary to establish all recipes you know from the show.)[/size][/font]
[size=3]
If you choose to learn all recipes before year 3, the Exclusive Edition is what you are looking for, and it is available only in certain days of the week.

If you choose to buy the book after year 3, you will also have the chance to buy the elusive Exclusive Edition, but the paperback will be available everyday.
[/size][center]
~ Oh! And Clint is no longer mistaking the Queen of Sauce cookbook with a geode!﻿ ~[/center][size=5][u][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][center]﻿[/center][center]~~~Languages and Credits~~~[/center][/color][/font][/u]
[/size]
[list]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]English - Special thanks to [color=#e69138]ch0opera[/color] for the revision and all the help![/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Portuguese (PT-BR) - thanks Celia for the support! [/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Japanese - Translated by [color=#e69138]Thukino[/color] in this link: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16060][u]Queen of Sauce Cookbook - Japanese Translation[/u][/url][/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3]Chinese - Translated by ﻿﻿[/size][/font][font=Arial][color=#e69138][size=3]dajiebiebiwo [/size][/color][/font][font=Arial][color=#f4f4f4][size=3](Thank you!)[/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=3][color=#f4f4f4]Spanish - Translated by [/color][color=#e69138]Juanpa98ar[/color][color=#f4f4f4] in this link: [/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16684][u]Queen of Sauce Cookbook - Spanish Translation[/u][/url]﻿[/size][/font]
[/list][size=3][font=Arial]
If you have a translation, I'm interest in including it in my updates, if you don't publish it yourself!
If you find anything that needs correction, please tell me.[/font]

[/size][center][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=3][size=5][u]~~~Co[/u][/size][/size][size=3][size=5][u]nsiderations~~~[/u][/size][/size][/color][/font][/center]
[font=Arial][size=3]

[/size][size=3]This mod idea started with a "Why nobody thought about it?", that was soon follow by a "Hum...". It, than, became a "Oh! That's why..." until it becomes what it is now: "Well, that's the best I could thought about... I hope it can help you!"[/size]
[/font][font=Arial][size=4][center]﻿[/center][center]I also accept any tip, help, explanation or advisement about the language or the mod making.[/center][/size][/font]
Thank you for taking an interest!
